stat_status: Numeric capability fields are stored design intent, not validated conditioning inputs. Only explicit movement descriptions and path/time constraints drive this pilot.

profiles.label: Neutral control
profiles.prompt: A person runs forward steadily with a relaxed upright torso and natural arm swings.

calibration_protocol.control_target_space: SOMA source descriptors; target rig absolute angles reported separately, preservation judged against matched baseline deltas.
calibration_protocol.text_target_status: Adjectives are ordinal requests; degree targets are engineering comparisons, not numerical model conditioning.
calibration_protocol.deterministic_order: Apply upper-body edits after frozen stance cleanup, on the neutral take; separately apply to full raw motion for diagnostics. No rerun of loop selection after edit.
calibration_protocol.release_rule: Each enabled level must pass source control accuracy, unchanged-lower-body and inherited quality gates on both calibration seeds and held-out seed 55. Control must be ordered at all seeds and preserve ordering/deltas on target. Failed levels remain experimental; no claim of realism or unseen-rig reliability.

scope: One newly reserved neutral take, generated after periodic-editor freeze. Reuse the exact verified neutral prompt embedding; no encoder changes.
